changelog: Posters now show progress: status, percentage, a progress bar and a detail line drawn onto each placeholder poster (title card when there is no artwork), redrawn as the status changes. Existing placeholders are redrawn once after updating.
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
name: Coming Soon
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr
